content: Filament 5.x docs (filamentphp/filament 5.x branch, read 2026-10-16; latest v5.10.2): List pages support getTabs() with Tab::make()->modifyQueryUsing() and badges; table bulk actions via BulkAction::make() in toolbarActions(), authorizeIndividualRecords(), reportBulkProcessingFailure(), deselectRecordsAfterCompletion(), checkIfRecordIsSelectableUsing(), chunkSelectedRecords(); custom resource pages via make:filament-page --resource --type=custom, record pages with InteractsWithRecord + resolveRecord(); View pages can use infolists; infolists support custom entries (Blade) and key-value/repeatable entries.
